summary_1line: The Pandavas plan disguises for their incognito year in Virata’s court, with Arjuna as a eunuch dance teacher, Nakula a horse-keeper, and Sahadeva a cowherd.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna describes disguising himself as the eunuch Brihannala, imagining bangles covering his bow-scarred arms and a long braid falling from his head.
The Pandava brothers sit together in council as Yudhishthira asks each what humble role he will take in King Virata’s palace.
Nakula proudly stands among fine horses, explaining how even wild colts become gentle under his skilled care.
